title: Instruction locations in a while loop
statement: Let $P$ be a finite list of WordRAM instructions, let $G$ be a code layout, let $pos$ be a natural number, let $c$ be a condition, and let $s$ be a statement. If the instruction list produced by compiling the while loop with condition $c$ and body $s$ at position $pos$ is a prefix of the suffix of $P$ beginning at $pos$, then the compiled condition is a prefix of $P$ beginning at $pos$, the compiled body is a prefix beginning at $pos + \mathrm{size}(c)$, and the single instruction that conditionally jumps back to $pos$ is a prefix beginning at $pos + \mathrm{size}(c) + \mathrm{size}_{G.F}(s)$.
hypotheses_covered: The compiled while-loop instruction list is a prefix of the instruction list obtained by dropping the first $pos$ instructions of $P$.
